summary: Iteration 6 testing of View/Clip admin 2FA (TOTP) and IP allowlist. Backend: 100% pass (24 tests). Frontend: All 2FA UI elements verified. Admin login two-step flow, 2FA setup/enable/disable, and IP allowlist health check all working correctly.

backend_2fa_features: GET /api/admin/auth/2fa/status - returns {enabled: false, pending_setup: false} for admin with no 2FA
GET /api/admin/auth/2fa/status - requires admin role (403 for non-admin)
POST /api/admin/auth/2fa/enable with correct pyotp code → {message: '2FA enabled'}, status.enabled=true
POST /api/admin/auth/login WITHOUT totp_code after 2FA enabled → {require_2fa: true, message: ...} (NO token)
POST /api/admin/auth/login WITH correct totp_code → {token, user, portal: 'staff'} AND audit_log action='admin.auth.success' meta.twofa=true
POST /api/admin/auth/login WITH bad totp_code → 401, audit_log action='admin.auth.2fa_failed'
POST /api/admin/auth/2fa/disable with correct code → {message: '2FA disabled'}, status.enabled=false
Regression: admin login without 2FA still works and creates audit 'admin.auth.success' entry
backend_regression: System health shows 3 DB layers (identity, streaming, vault)
frontend: /admin/login page has data-testid: admin-login-email-input, admin-login-password-input, admin-login-submit-btn
/admin/login two-step flow: creds → require_2fa → TOTP step with admin-totp-step, admin-totp-code-input, admin-totp-submit-btn, admin-totp-back-btn
Admin Command Center → System tab shows version v1.3.0
System tab shows 3 DB layers (Identity, Streaming, Vault) with latencies
System tab shows Encryption info (Fernet AES-128-CBC + HMAC-SHA256, Vault Key Loaded)
System tab shows Cloud Streaming Provider hot-swap grid with Direct URL (mock) active
System tab shows System Actions (Reload Settings, Deploy Update, Rotate Keys)
System tab shows System Events and Audit Log with 2FA events
System tab has Two-Factor Authentication (TOTP) card with data-testid=twofa-card
2FA card shows twofa-setup-btn when 2FA not enabled
After clicking setup: twofa-qr (QR code), twofa-secret, twofa-enable-code-input, twofa-enable-btn all present

critical_code_review_comments: AdminLogin pydantic model correctly has optional totp_code field
admin_login endpoint correctly handles require_2fa case (returns 200 with require_2fa=true, no token)
admin_2fa_setup correctly generates TOTP secret, QR code, and stores totp_secret_pending
admin_2fa_enable correctly validates code with pyotp.TOTP.verify(valid_window=1)
admin_2fa_disable correctly validates code before disabling
admin_system_health correctly reports admin_ip_allowlist_enabled and admin_ip_allowlist_count
All 2FA operations create audit_log entries with IP address

test_credentials.pyotp: Used pyotp.TOTP(secret).now() to generate valid TOTP codes during testing

seed_data_creation: Multiple test users created during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 adds TOTP 2FA for admin login and IP allowlist for /api/admin/* endpoints. 2FA flow: setup → enable → next login requires code → disable optional. IP allowlist is DISABLED by default (ADMIN_IP_ALLOWLIST='' in env). When enabled, requests from unlisted IPs get 403 with audit 'admin.ip.blocked'. All 2FA operations are audited. Version is 1.3.0. IMPORTANT: After testing 2FA, always disable it on the admin account to leave system in clean state.

mocked_apis.Google Cloud Live Stream: POST /api/streams returns mock ingest/playback URLs when GCP creds not configured

2fa_endpoints.POST /api/admin/auth/2fa/enable: Validates code, enables 2FA, creates audit log
2fa_endpoints.POST /api/admin/auth/2fa/disable: Validates code, disables 2FA, creates audit log

admin_login_with_2fa.with_correct_totp_code: Returns {token, user, portal: 'staff'}, audit action='admin.auth.success' meta.twofa=true

ip_allowlist.firewall_behavior: When enabled, unlisted IPs get 403 with {detail: 'IP not allowed'} and audit 'admin.ip.blocked'

frontend_components.TwoFactorCard: Setup button → QR + secret + code input + enable button → disable button when enabled
